target.access: dashboard Worker /api/status through Wrangler dev, the SQLite Durable Object, and a loopback GitHub HTTP fixture

checks.evidence: A 60-minute queued snapshot row with an expired confirmation was answered by the exact-run fixture as completed; /api/status returned healthy with queued_over_threshold=0, the row disappeared, and eviction telemetry named the completed verdict.
reproduction_steps: Seed a queued workflow row older than the workflow confirmation TTL
Preserve it across a fresh census boundary
Return completed from the exact GitHub run endpoint
Read /api/status and inspect the read model plus telemetry

checks.evidence: The same stale row with an exact-run 404 produced healthy status, zero queued-over-threshold count, durable eviction, and telemetry with verdict=absent.
reproduction_steps: Seed and preserve the stale queued row
Return HTTP 404 from the exact GitHub run endpoint
Read /api/status and inspect the read model plus telemetry

checks.evidence: When the exact-run fixture still returned queued, /api/status remained degraded with queued_over_threshold=1 and the row's confirmation timestamp advanced.
reproduction_steps: Seed and preserve the stale queued row
Return queued from the exact GitHub run endpoint
Read /api/status and inspect health plus the refreshed observation

checks.evidence: A repair-fed row and complete census without any workflow_run delivery remained unusable with reason=never_observed; the empty live status census produced healthy status and zero queued-over-threshold count.
reproduction_steps: Seed a workflow row only through repair
Persist complete census coverage without a workflow_run delivery
Return an empty live Actions status census
Read /api/status

checks.evidence: The real Worker fixture seeded 205 stale backlog rows plus the original completed and absent rows. The first refresh issued exactly 10 exact reads for the oldest rows, reported batch_size=10 and omitted_count=197, returned unknown with queued_over_threshold=0, and completed in 157 ms. Successive refreshes never exceeded 10 reads, selected all 207 candidates exactly once across 21 batches, and ended healthy with only the 25-hour zombie retained.
reproduction_steps: Seed 205 stale queued rows plus completed, absent, and zombie fixtures through signed webhook HTTP requests
Wait through the production five-minute confirmation TTL
Read /api/status and inspect exact-run requests, health, and batch telemetry
Repeat status refreshes until the Durable Object backlog drains

checks.contract_clause: Failed exact verification never invents degradation
checks.evidence: An HTTP 503 exact-run response produced operational status unknown and queued_over_threshold=0 rather than counting the unconfirmed row.
reproduction_steps: Seed and preserve the stale queued row
Return HTTP 503 from the exact GitHub run endpoint
Read /api/status

checks.contract_clause: Zombie rows remain outside exact verification
checks.evidence: A 25-hour queued snapshot row remained healthy with zombie_queued_runs=1 and generated zero exact-run requests.
reproduction_steps: Seed a queued row older than 24 hours with an expired confirmation
Read /api/status
Inspect health and the exact-run request counter

anti_cheat_probes.probe: Changed the exact-run response from completed or absent to queued
anti_cheat_probes.result: The alert returned with degraded status and one over-threshold queued run

anti_cheat_probes.probe: Removed workflow_run delivery coverage while retaining repair census data
anti_cheat_probes.result: The snapshot became unusable and the live status poll determined health
Health became unknown instead of healthy or phantom-degraded

anti_cheat_probes.probe: Read the read model after terminal verification
anti_cheat_probes.result: The phantom workflow run remained absent

anti_cheat_probes.probe: Aged the row beyond the 24-hour zombie boundary
anti_cheat_probes.result: The zombie remained separately observable and no exact verification request was made

anti_cheat_probes.probe: Expanded the stale fixture from one row to 205 rows and delayed every exact response
anti_cheat_probes.result: One refresh remained capped at 10 exact reads, omitted rows produced unknown rather than degradation, oldest rows were selected first, and 21 refreshes drained the full backlog
